messages:
Mira: PTAL on PR #4981 — addressed all requested changes from yesterday's review. Key changes: split flaky e2e into a separate job, added a unit test for the eviction edge case, tightened a retry backoff, and updated commit messages. Left a small TODO in the code for follow-up perf tuning. Can someone approve so I can schedule a canary? https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/4981

Alex: Will skim now. Do you have a perf regression number or quick bench results?

Mira: No meaningful regression locally; micro-bench harness shows p95 ≈ 123ms -> 125ms (within noise). Also ran a small end-to-end with the canary dataset — no obvious regressions.

Jordan: Quick skim — overall looks good. One nit: could you squash the fixup commits into the main change? Prefer a single logical commit for tracing in release notes.

Mira: Yep, can do. Also left one inline comment about reducing a debug log; will amend and push a squash.

Tess: PTAL after squashing, Mira — if it's clean I'll +1 and can kick off the canary. We have capacity for a light canary at 18:00 UTC today.

Mira: Squashed and pushed (`git rebase -i` -> force push). CI rerun triggered: https://ci.example/4981/build/782 — waiting on the integration suite.

ci-bot: Build succeeded — all checks passed (unit, e2e-split, lint).

Tess: +1 — approving now. Mira, could you open a canary ticket or ping infra to reserve the 18:00 UTC slot?

Mira: Filed canary ticket #654 and pinged infra. @infra-team please reserve 18:00 UTC canary slot for PR #4981.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved for PR #4981 at 18:00 UTC. Will post results to #incidents and this thread once the run completes.

Jordan: LGTM, nice cleanup :tada:

Mira: Thanks everyone! Marking this thread resolved for now. If the canary shows regressions I'll rollback and post details here.
